attributes.text: The postcode is sent to TfL as you typed it, so TfL can find the start. It is not sent to OpenStreetMap.
Your phone will ask permission once. We read your location one time, round it to about 100 metres, and do not keep it.
Location is switched off for this app and the phone will not ask again. Choose a station or type a postcode instead, or turn it on in the phone's settings.
